description:
FOUND s461ar while measuring what still blocks `t/re/pat.t` after #931 removed
its census drop.  PRE-EXISTING.

perl's `t/loc_tools.pl` (loaded by 16+ files in the companion population, and
by re/pat.t through its own helper chain) has:

    return 0 if ! defined &DynaLoader::boot_DynaLoader;
    if (! ${^SAFE_LOCALES}) {
        return 0 if $^O eq 'os390';
        require threads;                 # <-- PCL arrives here
        return 0 if threads->tid() != 0;
    }

Probed 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl: `defined &DynaLoader::boot_DynaLoader` is 1 in BOTH
(so the early return does not fire in either), and `${^SAFE_LOCALES}` is 1 in
perl and UNDEF in PCL.  That single divergence sends PCL down a branch perl
never takes, and `lib/threads.pm` dies "This Perl not built to support
threads" -- killing the file at LOAD.

WHAT IT IS: a Config-derived read-only scalar, true on a perl whose locales are
thread-safe.  PCL is single-threaded, so 1 is the honest answer, and it is one
entry in the caret-variable table (%SPECIAL_VARS / the caret cell list that
$^C, $^E, $^R already use -- see Pl/t/caret-vars-01.t).

WHY IT IS NOT A ONE-LINE FILLER: making it 1 ENABLES the locale test paths in
16+ companion files that today bail out early, so the blast radius is a
companion `--all --quick` run and a snapshot re-read, not a probe.  Do it as
its own change with that bar.  Note also that re/pat.t has a SECOND blocker
behind this one (task #935), so it will not gain rows on its own.

BAR: `${^SAFE_LOCALES}` reads 1 and is read-only as perl's is; the 16 files
that `require loc_tools.pl` measured before and after, every mover attributed;
`--quick` companion; full sweep (a caret-variable table entry is runtime).
subject: ${^SAFE_LOCALES} reads undef, so t/loc_tools.pl takes perl's unsafe-threads branch and dies in `require threads`
